metadata.title: Capillary $L_p$ dual Minkowski flow
metadata.abstract: For $n\geq2$ and $\theta\in(0,\pi/2)$, we study the long-time existence and asymptotic behavior of an even normalized capillary $L_p$ dual Minkowski flow in the Euclidean half-space $\overline{\mathbb{R}^{n+1}_+}$. When $pq\geq0$, the flow exists for all positive time and the evolving hypersurfaces converge smoothly along a sequence of times tending to infinity to a stationary solution of the normalized problem. If $p\neq q$, a dilation of the limit solves the unnormalized problem.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.progressType: 偶对称毛细Lp dual Minkowski流
analysis.workSummary: n≥2、锐角θ∈(0,π/2)下，研究欧氏半空间偶对称归一化毛细Lp dual Minkowski流。pq≥0时全正时间存在，沿趋于无穷的时间序列光滑收敛到归一化平稳解；p≠q时适当缩放极限解未归一化问题。
analysis.breakthrough: 给出参数pq≥0下的长时流解及Minkowski平稳解构造。
analysis.limitations: 摘要仅保证子列收敛，不是全流收敛或唯一性；p=q时不能套用同一缩放得到未归一化解；偶性、锐角及n≥2不可删。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。

analysis.priorityReason: 几何流与凸几何PDE主线结果，条件明确。
